Hi lovely people 🌸 — I'm a bit lost after receiving some conflicting information this week.

Two things I'm trying to figure out:
1. I am Osek Patur since 2024. *The Bituach Leumi office @ AKKO told me that on a B1 visa I can't register or pay contributions at all *— but my accountant, through his BL contacts, was told the opposite. 

**What's true? And has anyone here on a B1 (self-employed) managed to register with Bituach Leumi? I'd love to hear how you did it.**

1. Has anyone received the hospitalization grant (מענק אשפוז) for their birth through their Israeli partner as yeduim betzibur, without being married? And how?
2. 

And if anyone can recommend a lawyer or advisor who really understands Bituach Leumi for foreign partners, I'd be so grateful for the referral. 🙏

A little about us: I'm Dutch, here on a B1 visa, self-employed Osek Patur, paying my taxes since 2024. 

My partner is Israeli, also self employed for the last few years, he pays BL, tax etc, 

We're expecting our first baby in November 💛 We are not married, though we are looking into getting married online. 

I know some will say we should have married first — noted with love, but I'm looking for what's possible from where we are now today. 

Thanks for responding!
